# One rate: 0.17 CAD for a Hong Kong dollar, on 2024-12-01.
#
# What this fixture produces: one price in the book's price database, which
# `account-balance` reads to convert HKD when no rates file is passed.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_account_balance_reads_the_rates_the_book_holds.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2024-12-01"
	value: "0.17"
